dimensions.justification: Specific and solution-agnostic, tied to the user test and analytics figures (M-1, M-2); the total number of affected users and any workaround are stated as unknown.

Both figures (M-1, M-2) were only spoken in the meeting: no provider data, no evidence cards, no anecdote records. The sample of 8 test users is small and sections 6a to 6c say so, but spoken evidence is a claim, so this is a 2.
dimensions.fix: Close the gaps in 6c: configure a data provider and an anecdote source, re-run the figures through them, and attach a confidence level to each figure.

dimensions.justification: The notes state no strategy link and the product vision and strategy in the config are placeholders; the PRD only ties the work to the backlog decision (D-1).
dimensions.fix: Fill in the product vision and strategy document, then state how the notification work serves them and whether it belongs on the roadmap rather than only the backlog.

dimensions.justification: One primary metric (MET-001) with a labelled proposed target and timeframe, a known baseline from the user test (M-1), one guardrail with a baseline (M-2) and stated instrumentation.
Non-goals in section 7 and in/out lists in section 13 keep the two parked problems and the outage out, consistent with decisions D-2 and D-3.
No effort estimate, no owner for the data work and no check that an unread count can be computed; only assumptions are listed.
dimensions.fix: Get an effort estimate from Engineering, confirm the unread count can be computed per user, and name data owners for the re-measurement.
